title: Vacuum Polarization Energy of a Nonzero Radius Cosmic String Induced Spacetime
summary: We calculate the vacuum polarization energy (VPE) of a scalar field in the background of a nonsingular cosmic string in $2+1$ spacetime dimensions. Our calculation expresses the VPE as a renormalized sum and integral over scattering data, which can be expressed in terms of Legendre and Bessel functions for the "ballpoint pen" model, analogous to a square well in curvature, and which can be obtained numerically for a generic string profile.
